main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (rows 0-30) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Canopy top: light-to-mid greens at rows 1-10 read as the upper, sunlit mass of the foliage; no separate flat horizontal surface, since it is a rounded organic volume
evidence: The organic canopy is a rounded volume lit from above. Its lighter upper foliage gives way to darker lower foliage, with a dark shadow band around rows 15-18 and a dark underside at rows 28-31 above the trunk. The grass patch at the base is seen from above. There are no receding side faces, and it is not a flat elevation or plan view. It reads as a 3/4 tree comparable to the references.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens (deep teal-green, dark, mid, light, highlight) in clumped dithered patches, and the outline is a dark green tone rather than black. The trunk has a lighter left edge, brown mid-tones and a dark base, with a grass patch of 3 greens. Compared with the references, the leaf clumps are blockier and less individually defined, and the trunk is a plain straight column with no roots or branches, so it reads somewhat softer and less detailed. It is still a solid, coherent piece that sits acceptably beside the references.
